title: flowproof agent-trace side-effect lane v1
description: The `side_effects` lane an `app: agent` trace document may carry, and the records inside it. Deliberately describes the lane only, not the whole agent-trace document.

side_effect.description: One observed side-effect ATTEMPT, never an outcome claim: the fs observation replies CONTINUE before the kernel runs the call.

kind.description: fs_write and http_request are capturable; db_change and sap_transaction are RESERVED - documented, never emitted in Phase A.

target.description: fs: the hygiene-processed workspace-relative path (`./`-prefixed; a rename renders `src -> dst`). http: `ip:port`, or an unresolved `${VAR}` allow-entry spelling.

target_note.description: Why target is absent or weakened, e.g. `outside workspace (sha256:...)`.

op.description: fs: the syscall name. http: the transport (tcp/udp).

flags.description: fs only: the closed flag renderings, e.g. `O_WRONLY|O_TRUNC`.

at_ms.description: Monotonic ms since agent spawn, never wall clock.

before.description: RESERVED, never emitted in Phase A.

after.description: RESERVED, never emitted in Phase A.

diff.description: RESERVED, never emitted in Phase A.

observation.description: The observation tag the recording ran under, e.g. `observed (linux seccomp)`. Observation vocabulary only - never `enforced`.

effects.description: The observed effects, ordered by at_ms. Absent when empty.

faults.description: Supervisor adjudication failures: an empty effects list under one is silence, not evidence.
